predictions: We're obviously short one result from last week so far, but in the ones we do have, I went a stout 20-6 (and my six incorrect picks included a 1001, two more that were decided by a single dart, and a team that showed up with only four flippin' players!). Amazingly, I'm above 72% correct in every division but F so far, which brings my record to 59-21 (73.8%) overall. If only I wasn't a somewhat pathetic 3-6 in F after three weeks… including two teams with whom I'm still winless.

Match of the week: (B Div.) Consistently Inconsistent @ Why So Serious? The Possee already sits 3-0 in B, and the winner here will soon be there as well. While this match is in B now, this pairing often actually meets in A. Lots of talent here. I'll go Inconsistent, 13-11.

Match #2: (D Div.) Dart Knights @ Point & Rally. Are these the only undefeated teams in D? Certainly possible. That means that by the end of this one, the winner could be standing alone atop D. This feels like a title-match preview already. Titles are won with Rallies… 14-10.

Match #3: (F Div.) Death Throw @ Down to F, Again. Death Throw sat a week, then managed to squeeze out a pair of 14-10 wins, and poof, they now sit alone undefeated in F. Every match in F feels like it could go either way, so a 3-0 start would be gold. But this is F… DTF, 13-11.

Match #4: (E Div.) Heart of Dartness @ What's the Point? Dartness re-entered the discussion with a big win last week, while undefeated Point had the night off. This one could go a long way toward shaping how the E race looks in the end. I think I'm still feeling Point, 14-10.

Match #5: (H Div.) SofaKings @ Red-eye Rangers. The Rangers got kinda housed last week. And Sofa was pushed a bit harder than might have been expected. But this is still two of the five-team lead pack separated by a single match. At least until Sofa rolls a bit again, 16-8.

Match #6: (H Div.) Dirty Darts (Done Dirt Cheap) @ Double Vision. Here are two more of the five-pack I mentioned in the match above, but I think the real story line here is maybe the determination of who is the top Sofa-chasing team. Pretty sure that team is Vision, 14-10.

Match #7: (C Div.) Projectile Dysfunction @ Area 501. 5 of the 8 C teams already have 2+ losses. If Area takes this, that jumps to 6 of the 8, making C a two-horse race. Two horses it shall be, 14-10.
Match #8: (B Div.) Liquor Possee @ The Kids who say "Ni!" There are 3 undefeated B teams (including Possee), and 3 with 2+ losses. So where do the Kids fit? Bottom half says Possee, 14-10.

Match #9: (F Div.) Cheap Shots @ Two Time. I say it everywhere, F is a mess. So this matchup of two of the four 1-loss teams is likely critical. We all know I get F all wrong, so let's guess. Cheap, 13-11.
Match #10: (A Div.) Dart Attack @ Son of a Beach. These teams are both winless. And yet it's absolutely possible this could later determine who ends as a top-four-in-all-of-RDL team. Beach, 14-10.
Match #11: (C Div.) Brutha Ducks @ Mulligans Mafia. With the odd shape of the C stack so far, the winner and loser here could be 3rd and last, respectively, next week. It's the Made Men, 13-11.

Match #12: (D Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Shooter McGavin. If the Bandits won the missing match, this would be a chance to lock in a slot in D's top two so far. I'll go Bandits, but this is close, 13-11.
